metric_scope.cold: per NPU: request 0 admission through request 5 completion; six-request TTFT cohort and six-request compute busy time
metric_scope.warm: per NPU: request 1 admission through request 5 completion; request 1--5 TTFT cohort and request 1--5 compute busy time
metric_scope.ttft: completion minus admission; external arrival queue wait excluded
metric_scope.utilization: compute busy / per-NPU cohort window, then equal-weight mean across all 128 NPUs
